description: This PHP file defines the 'SqlMigrationCommand' class, which integrates a database migration library into the Goteo console system. It provides command-line options to manage SQL schema migrations such as creating migrations, applying updates, checking status, and installing the database schema.

classes.name: SqlMigrationCommand
classes.description: A console command class that manages SQL database migrations within the Goteo application, supporting commands like 'create', 'status', 'all', 'up', 'down', and 'install'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, and help text for the SQL migration command.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the configuration array required for the LibMigration Migration object, based on console input and application settings.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the migration command logic based on user inputs, supporting creating migrations, running migrations, checking status, and installing the database schema.
